main_text.l: PHILOSOPHIÆ THEORETHICÆ In Academia Lausannensi Professore meritissimo,

Δόξειε δ' ἂν ἴσως βέλτιον εἶναι καὶ δεῖν ὅπι σωτηρία γε τ' ἀλη- θείας καὶ τὰ οἰκεῖα ἀναιρεῖν ἄλλως τε καὶ φιλοσόφως ὅτας ἀμφοῖν γὰρ ὄντοιν φίλοιν ὅσιον προτιμᾶν τὴν ἀλήθειαν. Arist. lib. I. de Moribus cap. 4.
Excudebat ILLUSTRISSIMÆ REIPUBLICÆ BERNENSIS TYPOGRAPHUS, Georgius Sonnleitnerus.

page.notes: Handwritten marks in the upper right ("15") and lower left shelf mark, a purple library stamp and a grey stamp at the right and lower right are not printed text. The Greek line is printed in Greek letters; some Greek and the handwritten insertion "Iuuenibus" near "Ad diem" are doubtful. The word after "loco" is partly obscured by a handwritten mark.
